newsitem.title: UK: Euro oil swaps broadly steady, bar easier mogas.
newsitem.headline: Euro oil swaps broadly steady, bar easier mogas.

text.p: European oil swaps were mostly steady to a touch weaker on Wednesday bar easier gasoline.
Crude CFDs were up to five cents stronger, fuel was 50 cents lower and gasoline was down $2.

Brent CFDs gained a couple of cents with June 18-20 pegged at -42/43 cents against August from -47 cents with June 23-27 assessed at -30 cents from -35 cents. June 30-July 4 was put at -28 cents from -33 and July 7-11 was -28/29 cents against August from -33 cents.
Dealers said June 23-27 was traded at August -30 cents, June 23-27 was done versus July 14-18 at -4 cents and July 14-18 traded versus July 21-25 at -5.
Heavy fuel slipped 50 cents or so with July valued at $83 with physical barges traded at $85 and a touch below.
Gasoline slipped around $2 with futures in a quiet market. Wet eurograde traded at $191 fob ARA and July swaps were valued at $185 with August and September flat.
Naphtha was unchanged and quiet with July, August and September all hovering around $180.
